label: article-geometry
js: (() => { const sec = document.querySelector('[data-testid="start-articles"]'); if (!sec) return 'NO start-articles'; const arts = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="start-article"]')]; const sc = document.querySelector('.start-scroll'); return JSON.stringify({ count: arts.length, scrollH: sc ? sc.scrollHeight : null, clientH: sc ? sc.clientHeight : null, scrollTop: sc ? sc.scrollTop : null, secRect: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(sec.getBoundingClientRect())), arts: arts.map(a => { const r = a.getBoundingClientRect(); const p = a.querySelector('p'); const t = a.querySelector('a'); const cs = p ? getComputedStyle(p) : null; return { title: t ? t.textContent : null, rect: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(r)), pText: p ? p.textContent.slice(0,30) : null, pDisplay: cs ? cs.display : null, pColor: cs ? cs.color : null, pVis: cs ? cs.visibility : null }; }) }) })()

label: scroll-bottom
js: (() => { const sc = document.querySelector('.start-scroll'); if (sc) { sc.scrollTop = sc.scrollHeight; return 'scrolled ' + sc.scrollTop + '/' + sc.scrollHeight } return 'no .start-scroll' })()
